rows.note: This is the standard economic and government-policy term for austerity involving spending cuts or tax increases.

example.english: The government introduced austerity, cutting spending and raising taxes.
example.traditional: 政府推出緊縮政策，削減開支之餘仲加稅。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 teoi1 ceot1 gan2 suk1 zing3 caak3 soek3 gaam2 hoi1 zi1 zi1 jyu4 zung6 gaa1 seoi3

rows.note: Use this for austerity expressed as strict or harsh discipline, rather than as economic policy or plain living.

example.english: The austerity of their upbringing meant we were not allowed out at night.
example.traditional: 佢屋企一向嚴格管教，唔准我哋夜晚出街。
example.jyutping: keoi5 uk1 kei2 jat1 hoeng3 jim4 gaak3 gun2 gaau3 m4 zeon2 ngo5 dei6 je6 maan5 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this when austerity means living plainly and without adornment.

example.english: I like a life of austerity, so I do not need many decorations at home.
example.traditional: 我鍾意過簡樸生活，屋企唔使擺咁多裝飾。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 gwo3 gaan2 pok3 sang1 wut6 uk1 kei2 m4 sai2 baai2 gam3 do1 zong1 sik1
